corrections.was: the packet brief and docs/SHIP_AI_PATH_PLANNER.md's follow-up row list 009D9050 as one of the search routines
corrections.is: there is no routine at 009D9050. The address is inside 009D8CE0 BSP_ShipAi_PredictTrackCrossing's body, 009D8CE0-009D9141, and nothing in 009EC680's call tree reaches it
corrections.evidence: bsp.py lookup 009d9050 reports no function start and the enclosing candidate 009d8ce0; 009D9050 MOVSS dword ptr [ESP+48h],XMM0 is mid-expression

corrections.was: docs/SHIP_AI_PATH_PLANNER.md describes plan+2Ch as 'the search context 009EC697 hands to 009EC280' and include/bsp/ship_ai_path_planner.hpp types it std::uint32_t search_context
corrections.is: it is a float: the penalty a route pays when two consecutive corners sit on opposite sides of their zones. 009D9CE1 writes it zero and no other writer was found, so it is inert in the image
corrections.evidence: 009EC6D8 FLD float ptr [ESI+2Ch]; the adds at 009EC4D2, 009EC568, 009EC613 and 009EC62D, each guarded by an IMUL of the two signed +14h bytes at 009EC4CB, 009EC561, 009EC5FC and 009EC622

corrections.was: include/bsp/ship_ai_path_planner.hpp names node+31h short_link, 'set when link_minus_length is below one unit'
corrections.is: that is only its seed value. The flag means 'the link_minus edge has been proved clear', and +32h is the same flag for link_plus
corrections.evidence: 009E3573 and 009E3764 set them when the probe found no zone; 009D98AF sets +31h on a spliced link; 009D95CE clears it; 009D5A38/009D5A4C and 009E335F/009E336A are the only readers

corrections.was: include/bsp/ship_ai_path_planner.hpp types node+2Ch as an unnamed std::uint32_t field_2c
corrections.is: it is the back pointer of link_plus, exactly what +28h is for link_minus
corrections.evidence: 009D92F8 MOV dword ptr [EAX+2Ch],ESI inside 009D92E0 against 009D9248 MOV dword ptr [EAX+28h],ESI inside 009D9230; 009E34C5 and 009E36CD read the pair symmetrically before deciding whether to copy the far node

corrections.was: include/bsp/ship_ai_path_planner.hpp types node+14h as std::uint8_t field_14

corrections.evidence: 009D590B CMP byte ptr [ESI+14h],DL with 009D5911 SETL; 009D985B and 009D986D with JG and JL; 009EC4B1 and 009EC4C7 MOVSX
